components.name: Brood Crown
components.blurb: Nine cells of shield grown round one throne. The Queen wore it once. It has been wearing the hive ever since.
components.quirk: Four layers while 3 crew stand in its room, two otherwise (a Hive Battery makes three and one), and its layers come back faster: Kett swarm it. Found only on the Queen of Nine Cells.

components.name: Kiln Mantle
components.blurb: A shield cast in the wall of the Long Kiln, still warm after nine hundred firings. The Ash-Matron called it a blanket.
components.quirk: Three layers, a fourth while its room is above 60 heat, and layers come back in 4.5 s; it warms itself and scorches 0.5 hp a second off the crew in its room: Emberkin shrug the heat off. Found only on the Long Kiln.

components.name: Conductor's Helm
components.blurb: The baton, the podium and the helm in one fitting. The Choirmaster never explained which of the three steers.
components.quirk: Evasion +0.2 while a Prismatic is in its room (a Resonance Helm gives 0.1); with none it is a plain helm that draws one power more. Found only on the Cathedral of Seven Notes.

components.name: Anvil Plating Bay
components.blurb: Quarried plate laid so thick over every wall of the room that the room has stopped being a room and become a position.
components.quirk: The walls of its room get +100% hp in a fight (a Stonehide Bay gives +50%), but the room cannot keep its air (3% a second): Basalt do not breathe. Found only on the Deepcut Anvil.

components.name: Grove Veil
components.blurb: Mother's own web, thinned to a veil and hung in the dark of the hull. It knits as it is cut, and does not apologise.
components.quirk: Three layers that come back in 3 s (a Mycelium Shield makes two in 3.7 s), but the shield breathes the room's air (1.5% a second). Sporeling auras put air back. Found only on Mother's Bloom.

components.name: Fenwater Heart
components.blurb: The core of the Slow Tide, still beating at the speed of weather. It was cut out and handed over. It still sulks in the dry.
components.quirk: +4 power over a Reactor Mk1 (a Wetwell Reactor gives +2), with the same fire risk of 0.02 a second in its room. Mire put fires out twice as fast and take half the burn. Found only on the Slow Tide.

components.name: Fair Exchange Drive
components.blurb: A drive the Broker was never seen to pay for. The receipt, when it turns up, will be in somebody else's name.
components.quirk: Thrust 27 (x1.5 over a Mk2) and it malfunctions only 10% a minute (a Haggle Engine makes 23 and 20%): the Fenn mend it in no time. Found only on the Fair Exchange.

components.name: Overseer's Drive
components.blurb: Wired by the Overseer for the Overseer's own taste in current. Everything else on the ship has learned to cope.
components.quirk: Thrust x1.7 (31) with a mechanical crew member in its room; without one it makes the Mk2's 18. It shocks organic crew in its room (1 hp a second). Found only on Spare Parts Prime.

components.name: Ramhead Thrusters
components.blurb: Four bells the size of doors on a barge that has only ever wanted one thing. They are warm to the touch, and eager.
components.quirk: Thrust x1.8 (33) with a Grundl in its room tending the fuel cells; without one it makes 20. The heavy mass cannot be set from a pack. Found only on the Last Barge.

components.name: Commodore's Comms Array
components.blurb: A flag officer's listening post, with every registry in Concord space on speed dial. Most of them pick up.
components.quirk: A radar that names every contact within 3200 px and sees the hidden ones too (a Comms Array names within 2400). Found only on the Concord Ascendant.
